AMET.name: Annual
AMET.definition: Meeting held periodically to approve the financial statements and to elect the board members and the auditors.

CLAS.name: Class
CLAS.definition: Meeting for holders of a specific type of asset, for example, preferred shares, bonds.

ISSU.name: Issuer Initiated
ISSU.definition: Meeting is the result of an obligation or a decision made by the issuer as opposed to voting rights holder initiated, for example, contested meeting.

OMET.name: Ordinary
OMET.definition: Meeting which is planned in the by-laws.

VRHI.name: Voting Rights Holder Initiated
VRHI.definition: Meeting is the result of a request or an action of a voting right holder(s), for example, contested meeting.
